reasons.reader_question: Specific and earned: the torn rubbing's last word, now to be read by queen and prince together. The opening hook is weak.
reasons.change: Oath broken, commission and archive lost, bond ended, Neshar self-ruled. Power and knowledge both shift visibly.
reasons.romance_movement: The new reason lands: 'I'll still take your word' / 'That's the new part.' 'Not alone' proves it again under pressure.
reasons.shown_chemistry: Warm pencil leads, lurching when she lurches, the hand laid flat beside hers, the reflexive palms-out. All responsive action.
reasons.character_logic: Ila sits on the rubbing forty days with Bindu downstairs and Kiran unmentioned. The queen grants four sweeping demands at once.
reasons.stakes_and_cost: Ila pays the commission and then the archive. Kunal's petition carries no risk; the queen grants it without resistance.
reasons.prose: Clean and readable with no banned phrases. But the copying montage summarises, 'low and plain' echoes, and it runs about 3,500 words.
reasons.continuity: Kunal shows 'both hands ... grey to the second joint'; F644/F749 say only the right fingertips are dead. Rohan's day-18 return conflicts with F784.

fixes: At 'held up both hands to her, palms out, grey to the second joint', the hands conflict with F644/F749 (continuity). Make it 'held up both hands... the right grey at the tips, the left pink', so the reader sees one hand that never could vouch and one that no longer does. Also confirm Rohan's day-18 arrival in new-facts as superseding F782/F784.

At 'its last word that no one had read', the forty-day silence is a contrived delay (Bindu reads it in ch32). In the post-room scene, add one line: Ila keeps the rubbing folded unread because she promised Kiran first word, and Kiran is crossing with the council pairs. That makes the queen's demand collide with two promises, not one.

At 'Granted. All four. On one condition.', the petition succeeds without friction (stakes without depth). Have Sarala refuse the no-garrison clause first. Kunal then trades something costly in the open: his own name as surety if Pritam walks, or his council seat held personally answerable. Also replace the second 'low and plain' simile ('like the chair') to cut the echo.
reader_question: What does the torn last word of the Under-Cairn rubbing say, and what will the queen do when she reads it beside Kunal?
new_facts_assessment: Most new facts are necessary and consistent: Gauri's runners, the day-35 fold test, Harish by the door, Pell Orlan, the queen at 62. Rohan on day 18 contradicts provisional F782/F784; S7 must retire those. The east-bearing margin note fits F790, but 'I don't draw a way I haven't walked' strains against ch32's private dotted line; S7 should reconcile them. The lifelong archive ban is a strong cost and fits Book 3, where the archive opens to Lata, not Ila. A 1.75-span pace with the crutch versus F767's 1.25 is plausible as healing but unstated.
